notes.final_message:
I recorded two escaped bugs. Both are in "Order creation: quantities and totals". I recorded them under the name "Dev", taken from the git user, since you hadn't given one.

| Recorded as | Source | What went wrong | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|
| ESC-001 | Sentry, ACME-API-AE | Creating an order fails with a TypeError reading `tax` of undefined. There were 3 events on 1 Nov in production, none tied to a user. | important |
| ESC-002 | Linear, ENG-7 | Invoice totals are wrong for orders with a discount. Two customers reported it. | critical |

I marked ENG-7 critical because it involves wrong money. I marked the Sentry error important because it fails an order but doesn't lose or expose data
